methodologyNotes: Specs sourced from manufacturer pages (Apple support.apple.com KB articles, Samsung newsroom, Google Store, Garmin product pages, OnePlus product pages), corroborated against reputable review outlets (Android Police, Android Central, Expert Reviews, DCRainmaker, 9to5Mac/Google) and Wikipedia. Numeric specs are stored unit-free; units implied by key name (case_size_mm=millimetres, battery_hr=hours, weight_g=grams). battery_hr is the manufacturer-rated standard smartwatch/all-day figure (not GPS-only or low-power-mode); for Garmin watches with multi-day ratings the smartwatch-mode hours are used (14 days = 336 hr, 11 days = 264 hr, 5 days = 120 hr). case_size_mm is the primary/reference variant case diameter (Apple 42 mm for Series 10, 40 mm for Galaxy Watch 7, 41 mm for Pixel Watch 3). water_resistance is the deepest certified rating in metres (WR100 = 100 m; 5 ATM = 50 m; 10 ATM = 100 m). lte_option=true means a cellular/LTE SKU is available; false means no cellular variant exists. ecg=true means an ECG sensor is present and enabled in at least one primary market; noted in provenance if region-restricted. os is the operating system at launch. priceUsd is the US launch MSRP for the base/reference config noted in priceNote. null is used only for values that could not be confirmed from any fetched source. accessedAt is 2026-06-15 on every source.

products.name: Apple Watch Series 10 (42mm)
products.provenance: Case sizes (42 mm and 46 mm) confirmed by DCRainmaker review and 9to5Mac review, both citing Apple launch specs. Battery life 18 hr from Apple's official claim per both reviews. Price $399 (42 mm aluminum GPS) from DCRainmaker pricing section. Weight 30 g (42 mm aluminum Wi-Fi) from Android Police review spec table. LTPO OLED display confirmed by Android Police. watchOS 11 from DCRainmaker. ECG confirmed present on Series 10 (continued from Series 4+). Water resistance 50 m (5 ATM) from 9to5Mac. LTE cellular SKU available confirmed by DCRainmaker listing cellular prices.

products.name: Apple Watch Ultra 2
products.provenance: Apple support KB SP906 confirmed: 49 mm case, 36 hr battery (72 hr low-power), 100 m water resistance (WR100 + ISO 22810:2010), weight 61.4 g, dual-frequency L1+L5 GPS, LTE included, ECG app confirmed, September 2023 launch. Android Central review corroborated: $799 MSRP, 49 mm, LTPO OLED (502x410, 3000 nits), 36 hr rated, watchOS 10 at launch. weight_g rounded to 61 (61.4 g natural finish per Apple). The 2024 black-finish variant reused same hardware.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Watch 7 (40mm)
products.provenance: Wikipedia spec table: 40 mm case (40.4x40.4x9.7 mm), 1.31 in AMOLED display, 300 mAh battery, weight 28.8 g, Wear OS 5.0 / One UI Watch 6, ECG confirmed, IP68+5ATM (50 m) water resistance. Android Central review: $300 (40mm Wi-Fi) / $350 (LTE) MSRP confirmed; OS One UI Watch 6 (Wear OS 5). Expert Reviews (UK) confirmed 24-hr battery life claim. Galaxy Watch 7 released July 24 2024. weight_g rounded to 29 (28.8 g). battery_hr 24 per Expert Reviews citing Samsung rating; Android Police tested ~19 hr with all features on.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Watch 7 (44mm)
products.provenance: Wikipedia spec table: 44 mm case (44.4x44.4x9.7 mm), 1.47 in AMOLED, 425 mAh, weight 33.8 g. Android Central: $330 (44mm Wi-Fi) / $380 (LTE). Expert Reviews confirmed 24 hr Samsung rating. ECG and IP68+5ATM confirmed. weight_g rounded to 34 (33.8 g). Same OS as 40mm variant. Expert Reviews noted 33.7 g for 44mm (minor measurement variation vs Wikipedia 33.8 g).

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra
products.provenance: Wikipedia: 47.1x47.1x12.1 mm titanium case, AMOLED with sapphire crystal, A-GPS dual-frequency, IP68+10ATM (100 m), Wear OS 5.0 / One UI Watch 6, ECG confirmed, weight 60.5 g. Expert Reviews: 47 mm, 1.5-in Super AMOLED 480x480, 3000 nits, battery 60 hr with AOD on / 80 hr without, dual-frequency GPS, 10 ATM (100 m), ECG, weight 60 g. Android Police: $650 US launch price confirmed. weight_g rounded to 61 (60.5 g). battery_hr=60 is the AOD-enabled rated figure per Expert Reviews.

products.name: Google Pixel Watch 3 (41mm)
products.provenance: Android Police review and Google Store: 41 mm and 45 mm variants, LTPO AMOLED up to 2000 nits, Gorilla Glass 5, 24 hr Google-rated battery (AOD on) for both sizes (reviewer observed longer with mixed use), GPS single-frequency, LTE +$100, IP68 (5 ATM / 50 m), Wear OS 5, ECG confirmed, weight 31 g (41mm) and 37 g (45mm). Wikipedia: US release September 10 2024. priceUsd corrected to $349 — official Google launch MSRP for 41mm Wi-Fi (verified via Google Store and Android Authority launch coverage); LTE is $449. (Prior value $350 was an unsupported round-up.)

products.name: Google Pixel Watch 3 (45mm)
products.provenance: Android Police review: 45mm weight 37 g, same display/ECG/OS/GPS as 41mm, 420 mAh battery; reviewer observed 'easily 1.5-2-day' use with AOD. battery_hr corrected to 24 — Google's official rating is ~24 hr with AOD on for BOTH 41mm and 45mm (verified via Google Store and Android Authority); the prior 36 was a reviewer real-world figure, not the manufacturer all-day rating that this index standardizes on. priceUsd corrected to $399 — official Google launch MSRP for 45mm Wi-Fi (LTE $499); prior value $400 was an unsupported round-up.

products.name: Garmin Venu 3
products.provenance: Android Police review: 45x45x12 mm case, AMOLED 454x454, 14-day smartwatch-mode battery (=336 hr), single-band GPS, no LTE/cellular, 5 ATM (50 m), Garmin OS (proprietary), weight 30 g, US launch $450. Expert Reviews (UK): 45 mm, OLED 454x454, battery 'up to 14 days' (real-world ~5 days with AOD+GPS), single-band GPS, 5 ATM. Released August 2023. battery_hr=336 = 14×24. ECG: the Venu 3 shipped with Elevate V5 hardware that was NOT ECG-enabled at launch (Aug 2023); Garmin later enabled the ECG app for US owners after FDA clearance via software update. ecg=true reflects this index's methodology ('present and enabled in at least one primary market' — the US), NOT a launch-day capability. (Prior 'constant ECG monitoring' provenance quote was incorrect — that phrasing describes optical HR, not the ECG app.)

products.name: Garmin Forerunner 165
products.provenance: DCRainmaker review: 43 mm case, AMOLED 1.2-in 390x390, up to 11 days smartwatch mode (=264 hr), multi-GNSS GPS (not multiband), no LTE, 5 ATM (50 m), Garmin OS, no ECG (4th-gen HR sensor, no ECG), weight 39 g, $249 (non-music) / $299 (music). Wikipedia: 43 mm, AMOLED 390x390, 39 g, 5 ATM, released February 20 2024. battery_hr=264 = 11×24.

products.name: OnePlus Watch 3
products.provenance: Android Central review (primary spec table): 46.6x47.6x11.75 mm, 1.5-in LTPO AMOLED 466x466 2200 nits, 120 hr (5-day) smart mode battery (72 hr heavy / 16-day power-saver), dual-frequency GPS (L1+L5, BeiDou, Galileo, GLONASS, QZSS), no LTE, IP68+5ATM (50 m)+MIL-STD-810H, Wear OS 5+RTOS, ECG absent in North America (available internationally), weight 49.7 g without strap, US price $329.99. Corroborated by OnePlus US product page: 'Wear OS by Google', 5ATM+IP68, dual-frequency GPS, 5-day Smart Mode. Released April 2025 (delayed from announced February 2025). case_size_mm=47 (rounded from 46.6x47.6 mm outer). weight_g=50 (rounded from 49.7 g). ecg=false reflects US market reality; provenance notes international ECG availability.

products.name: Apple Watch SE (2nd generation)
products.provenance: Wikipedia article confirmed: Apple Watch SE 2nd gen released September 16 2022, 40mm and 44mm sizes, 18-hour battery, watchOS 9 at launch, does not include ECG or blood oxygen sensor ('does not include ECG and blood oximeter sensors'). Apple's current product page (accessed 2026-06-15) shows SE 3 as successor, confirming $249 as the original SE 2 starting price (widely reported at launch). weight_g corrected to 26 (Apple official tech specs page support.apple.com/111853: 40mm aluminum GPS = 26.4 g, rounded to 26). NOTE: the prior 33 g was the 44mm GPS figure (32.9 g) wrongly applied to this 40mm reference product. Water resistance 50 m (5 ATM). LTE cellular option available. OLED Retina display (non-LTPO). No ECG on any SE variant.

products.name: Fitbit Sense 2
products.provenance: Android Police review: 40.5x40.5x11.2 mm case (case_size_mm=41 rounded from 40.5 mm), 1.6-in 336x336 OLED display, 6+ days battery (=144 hr = 6×24), built-in GPS, no LTE option, 50 m water resistance, Fitbit OS (proprietary), ECG confirmed, $300 US MSRP, released September 2022. Wikipedia: confirmed 6+ days battery, 50 m waterproof, ECG, Fitbit OS, September 2022 release. weight_g corrected to 38 — official Google/Fitbit spec page lists 37.64 g (0.08 lb), corroborated by Tom's Guide review; rounded to 38. (Prior null was overly conservative; the value is confirmable from the manufacturer spec sheet.) battery_hr=144 = 6×24 using the 6-day rated figure (without AOD).
